📝 Lesson Observation & Analysis

Observe a colleague’s lesson, record evidence, rate each area and create a Word report. This is a professional-development observation tool, not an official teacher attestation decision.

1. Observation Details

2. Observation Rubric — 100 Points

Rate each of the 10 areas from 1 to 4. The app converts each rating into up to 10 points. Select “Not observed” if there was not enough evidence; the final percentage is calculated from the areas actually rated.

Rating scale: 4 = Highly effective · 3 = Effective · 2 = Developing · 1 = Needs substantial support · N/O = Not observed
